entries.headline: Plans choose their sources and reference each other
entries.summary: Control which integrations each plan consults, and reference other plans and runs in the planning conversation. Attach text files to bring context directly into the discussion with structured references and citations.

highlights.text: Choose which integrations each plan can access
Reference other plans and runs in conversation
Attach text files to bring context into planning

entries.headline: Plan in conversation and choose run context
entries.summary: Planning is now a live conversation with typed event responses. Every run chooses which sessions, timeframe and labels it reads, giving you control over what shapes each decision.

highlights.text: Chat with the planner instead of filling out forms
Pick which sessions and time windows each run reads
Label sessions to organize and filter across modes

entries.headline: One kind of thing: a session
entries.summary: Projects are gone and yeaboi opens straight on the modes. Anything that only existed inside a project is deleted, so export what you need first.

highlights.text: Sessions are the only container — no door to choose first
Project data is deleted, including anything only reachable through one
Sessions linked to a project now age out like every other session

entries.headline: Credentials show whether they actually work
entries.summary: Your saved credentials now show whether they actually work, with updated status whenever you change them. Settings fields guide you with lists and choices, so entries are validated and correct.

highlights.text: Credentials show whether they actually work, not just whether they exist
Settings fields guide entries with lists and validation
Pick Slack channels from your workspace during setup
See which environment variables unlock each destination

entries.headline: yeaboi opens straight into your modes
entries.summary: The terminal now opens on the door — a project, or a one-off session — rather than asking which world you are in first. Longer menus also keep their footer on screen, and a card opens the one you clicked.

highlights.text: Opens on the door instead of a world chooser
Longer menus keep their footer and their spacing on screen
Clicking a card opens that card, on every menu length

entries.headline: Projects track status and show what you've run in them
entries.summary: Every project now has a dedicated page showing which modes ran inside it and the context each one built. Mark projects done or in progress to keep your work organized.

highlights.text: See what each mode built inside your project
Mark projects done or in progress as you organize your work
Let Niko suggest project names and descriptions

entries.headline: Agent spend is accurate, security findings are actionable
entries.summary: Agent usage now tracks spend accurately by day, including every API call and tool cost. Security findings are grouped by issue with verdicts—you can dismiss false positives, replay the exact context, and apply one-click fixes.

highlights.text: See accurate daily agent spend with all API calls and tool usage costs included
Security findings group by issue with verdicts guiding which ones need action
Replay the exact code and context that triggered each security finding
Apply one-click fixes for common issues or dismiss them as test data

entries.headline: Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube Music join the library
entries.summary: Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube Music are now available as music sources on the desktop. Sign in to Spotify or YouTube Music to browse their libraries; Apple Music uses the system's Music app with keyless search.

highlights.text: Sign in to browse Spotify and YouTube Music libraries on desktop
Search Apple Music without signing in or installing apps
Music page and player settings tabs on the desktop

entries.headline: The front page comes to the terminal
entries.summary: The duck now waits under the world cards with the day's headline, on terminals of 49 rows or more. Press i to open the paper: yeaboi's release notes beside AI and engineering news, one story at a time.

highlights.text: The duck on the landing screen carries the latest headline in his bubble
A front page of its own, with the story's duck in costume in its scene

entries.headline: Desktop now fully supports Sessions and Projects
entries.summary: The desktop app now supports Sessions and Projects workflows with the same door-based navigation as the terminal. All project and session screens work identically across surfaces.

highlights.text: Sessions and Projects doors both available on desktop
Navigate projects and access project details on desktop

entries.headline: Choose between projects and one-off sessions
entries.summary: Every world now has two doors: Projects for organized, scoped work that shares context across runs, and Sessions for one-off explorations. Project runs in standup and analysis record defaults to reuse across your team.

highlights.text: Projects organize standup, retro, reporting and poker around one codebase
Sessions are quick one-off runs that don't tie to a project
See your recent work across all modes in one cross-mode list
Terminal door screen lets you toggle between Projects and Sessions workflows

entries.headline: Review your solo week and see today's plan
entries.summary: Solo is now single-person on every surface with dedicated prompts and engines. A new Weekly Review mode tracks your solo work week by week, and a today strip shows yesterday's progress.

highlights.text: Weekly Review: self-review your solo week with carried-forward actions
Today strip shows yesterday's progress and this week's agent spend
Solo standup, planning and reporting now use single-person prompts

entries.headline: Desktop projects now expose their planning capabilities
entries.summary: The desktop project flow was redesigned to fold planning into project navigation. This release corrects the route manifest to match what the desktop app actually has.

highlights.text: Desktop projects now correctly expose planning routes

entries.headline: Connect to 20 vendors and build your own integrations
entries.summary: Browse 20 built-in integrations from Datadog to Grafana, Linear and Trello as first-class trackers, and create your own API, webhook or MCP connections. Webhook events flow into your standup, performance and analysis views.

highlights.text: Browse 20 built-in integrations including Datadog, Grafana, AWS and more
Create custom API, webhook and MCP connections with your own config
Use Linear and Trello as first-class trackers alongside Jira and Azure DevOps
Receive webhook events in your standup, performance and analysis views

entries.headline: Desktop route manifest corrected
entries.summary: Nothing changes in how yeaboi works — this release is internal corrections to the desktop route manifest and parity checks, ensuring the desktop app builds against reality.

highlights.text: Desktop manifest now matches what the app generates

entries.headline: Work by project and pick your working world
entries.summary: Every mode now scopes to your active project, narrowing standup, retro and reporting to that work alone. The landing shows three working worlds: Team for groups, Solo for shipping solo, Agents for monitoring your coding bots.

highlights.text: Scope standup, retro, poker, performance and reporting to a single project
Three landing worlds: Team for sprints, Solo for shipping, Agents for monitoring
Toggle data sources off with incognito mode for sensitive analysis

entries.headline: Attach screenshots and logs to your feedback
entries.summary: The desktop feedback form now accepts screenshots and text log files. Attached logs appear as searchable details in your GitHub issue, while images get listed by path, and both improve AI Polish's understanding of problems.

highlights.text: Attach screenshots and log files from the desktop feedback form
Text log files become searchable details in your GitHub issue
Attached logs help AI Polish rewrite problems more accurately

entries.headline: System Check covers integrations and organizes by category
entries.summary: Your system health check now includes GitHub, Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Notion, and Slack readiness, plus your machine setup. Results organize into five areas so you can scan what matters at a glance.

highlights.text: GitHub, Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Notion and Slack readiness checks
Five category sections organize your system check for at-a-glance scanning
Icons and glyphs mark each category in the terminal for visual clarity

entries.headline: See your privacy settings and system health at a glance
entries.summary: The new Privacy page discloses every way data can leave this machine and lets you flip each real off-switch in place. A System Check page diagnoses missing optional prerequisites without causing any network traffic.

highlights.text: Every path data can take off this machine, disclosed and toggleable on the Privacy page
An offline System Check spots missing prerequisites before a feature trips over them
One switch on the tunnel group turns all board-sharing egress off at once

entries.headline: Reach six more AI models directly
entries.summary: yeaboi now works with Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Mistral, Qwen and GLM through their native endpoints. No extra install needed — each one rides the same OpenAI-compatible integration.

highlights.text: Choose from Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Mistral, Qwen and GLM in settings
Live discovery shows what models your API key can reach
Override any provider's endpoint for a regional host or custom deploy

entries.headline: Check your sharing setup before you publish
entries.summary: Settings can now tell you whether secure sharing is ready — sign-in, certificate and anything still missing — before you turn it on. You find out up front instead of when a share fails.

highlights.text: See whether Cloudflare Access is ready before you publish anything
Run the same checks a real share runs, before you switch sharing on

entries.headline: Meet Niko, an assistant across all your work
entries.summary: Ask Niko what a mode does, or what your plans, standups, retros and agent spend actually say, and it will take you to the screen that does the thing. Niko only reads — it never changes anything.

highlights.text: Read-only by design: Niko looks things up and points you the right way
Ask Niko from the terminal, the command line, the desktop app or your own tools
Saved conversations keep what Niko read, so an answer still shows its evidence
The welcome screen now needs a terminal at least 41 rows tall

entries.headline: The browser pages now install as their own package
entries.summary: Boards, share pages, exports and the slide deck are unchanged — they now arrive as a separate package. Upgrading or installing fresh picks it up for you.

highlights.text: Boards, share pages, exports and the slide deck behave exactly as before
Pinning yeaboi without resolving dependencies? Install yeaboi-web-assets too
Without it every board and export renders a blank page

entries.headline: Ship a whole epic, not just one story
entries.summary: Hand an epic, a story or a single task to the coding agent. For an epic, choose one pull request for the lot, or one per story stacked so a reviewer sees only that story's changes.

highlights.text: Ship an epic, a story or a single task
Land an epic as one pull request, or one stacked pull request per story
A failed story keeps what already shipped, and relaunching resumes there
Reopen, export or delete finished Ship runs from a saved-sessions screen

entries.headline: Watch a review gather its evidence
entries.summary: Performance now shows a live checklist of which source is being read, which are done, which found nothing and which failed. Export and share act on the review you are looking at.

highlights.text: See each evidence source finish, come back empty or fail, as it happens
What you watch and what the finished review says always agree
Export, share and anonymise act on the review on screen, not the newest one

entries.headline: Performance reviews show numbers, not paragraphs
entries.summary: Cycle time, story counts and test coverage now read as figures you can scan, each with evidence you can follow. The same review looks identical in the terminal, a browser and a share link.

highlights.text: See cycle time, story counts and test coverage at a glance
Jump from a claim to the work that evidences it
The same review reads the same in the terminal, a browser and a share link
Long reviews scroll properly, and big teams fit on screen

entries.headline: yeaboi now runs on Python 3.10
entries.summary: You no longer need Python 3.11 to install yeaboi. A new install script fetches its own Python, so you can install even when the Python on your machine is old or missing.

highlights.text: Runs on Python 3.10 and later
Install with a one-line script that brings its own Python
Clearer install instructions, whichever route you take

entries.headline: Bad credentials are caught before a run
entries.summary: Every mode that calls a model now confirms your credentials work first, so a missing or expired key stops you up front instead of quietly producing filler content.

highlights.text: An expired or missing key is caught before a mode opens
No more confusing placeholder output when credentials have lapsed
Patchy wifi will not block you — only a real rejection does
Usage and Settings open as always, since they call no model

entries.headline: Share boards with verified people only
entries.summary: An optional stricter sharing mode lets only people you have approved open a board, and checks who they are on the server. Setting it up is now a guided flow in Settings.

highlights.text: Restrict a shared board to people whose identity is verified
Set sharing up once with a guided flow in Settings
Impersonation is blocked on the retro, poker, share and Ship boards
Quick shares got fairer rate limiting and tighter tunnel handling

entries.headline: Run ceremonies from Slack with a reaction
entries.summary: React or reply on a ceremony post in Slack to pause, resume or skip it, vote on a signal, or leave a correction attributed to you. Only people you approve can do any of it.

highlights.text: Pause, resume or skip a ceremony with a reaction in Slack
Vote on signals, or reply in the thread to correct an artifact
Only people you approve can act, and it stays off until you say so
Skip a single scheduled run without pausing the whole ceremony

entries.headline: Redesigned retro and poker boards
entries.summary: Both live boards were rebuilt on one look and feel, with smoother movement, a clearer table and a layout that holds up in small windows and on phones.

highlights.text: Drag retro cards around and react to them from a floating tray
The facilitator rail shows past retros and can suggest action items
Poker duels announce whose turn it is, on a clearer table
Both boards adapt to small windows and phones

entries.headline: Sign in with your Claude subscription
entries.summary: Use a Claude subscription instead of an API key. You can authorise from inside yeaboi: it opens your browser, takes the code, and tells you when the sign-in needs refreshing.

highlights.text: Choose an API key or your Claude subscription in Settings
Sign in without leaving yeaboi — it opens a browser for you
You are told when a sign-in goes stale, and can refresh in place

entries.headline: Watch a Ship run from the browser
entries.summary: Ship runs now have a live board your teammates can follow: the phases, what the agent is doing, the diff, the checks and the cost. Guests only watch; you approve from the terminal.

highlights.text: Follow a Ship run live in a browser: phases, diff, checks and cost
Share the board with teammates, who can watch but not touch
Ship now finds plans built in the planning chat, not only saved ones

entries.headline: Put yeaboi on a schedule
entries.summary: Schedule a standup, a report or an agent digest to run at a set time on the weekdays you choose, and have it delivered to Slack, email or your terminal while yeaboi is closed.

highlights.text: Schedule standups, reports and agent digests to run unattended
Results arrive in Slack, email or your terminal while yeaboi is closed
Every run is recorded with its outcome, duration and cost
Spending caps, pauses and late-run guards keep unattended runs safe

entries.headline: A clearer activity timeline in Standup
entries.summary: The standup timeline now labels what happened — merged pull requests, ticket changes, bursts of commits — and links the lanes that touched the same pull request.

highlights.text: The timeline labels merged pull requests, ticket changes and commit bursts
Lanes that touched the same pull request are now visibly connected
Azure DevOps review votes and comments now reach your standup evidence
Busy days keep far more evidence instead of quietly dropping it

entries.headline: See the full diff before approving a Ship run
entries.summary: The approval step now shows the complete change in a scrollable pane beside the check results, and the buttons stay reachable however long it runs. The coding agent is locked down further.

highlights.text: Read the whole diff and the check results before you approve
Approve and reject stay on screen however long the diff
The coding agent can no longer run shell commands at all
Approval names the exact folder that will be touched

entries.headline: Faster documentation scoring in Analysis
entries.summary: Analysis scores documentation quality far faster than before, with identical results. If the faster path is unavailable, yeaboi falls back quietly and nothing changes for you.

highlights.text: Documentation quality scoring in Analysis is dramatically faster
Same scores as before, with a quiet fallback if the fast path is down

entries.headline: New: Ship turns a story into a pull request
entries.summary: Hand a story from your sprint plan to a supervised coding agent. It works on an isolated copy of your repo, its changes are checked, and nothing is pushed until you approve it.

highlights.text: Turn a user story into a pull request, with you approving the change
The agent works on an isolated copy and cannot push anything itself
Built-in spending limits stop a run before it gets expensive
Available in the terminal, on the command line and to your own tools

entries.headline: Pick prior-art repos in one pass, not one by one
entries.summary: Planning now offers every candidate repository in a single list you tick through, instead of asking about each one in turn. Skipping a repo only skips it for this project; you can also ban one for good.

highlights.text: Tick every relevant repository in one pass
Skip a repo for this project, or ban it from every future one
Reopening a saved plan asks the same question again, not a stale one

entries.headline: Every verdict now shows the evidence behind it
entries.summary: yeaboi keeps a tamper-evident record of how each decision was reached, so you can trace any signal back to the data that produced it. Standup also flags it when your sources disagree.

highlights.text: Trace any Standup or Performance verdict back to its source data
Standup raises a card when the board says done but a pull request is open
Performance preps and reviews record the tickets they were built from
Audit or trace the record from the command line or an assistant

entries.headline: Planning adds sprint targeting, options and a PRD
entries.summary: Small projects can drop stories into sprints you already have. Planning also proposes architecture options, writes acceptance criteria in your team's own style, and exports a full requirements document.

highlights.text: Assign stories to existing sprints instead of creating new ones
Acceptance criteria follow your team's own style across every export
Get two or three architecture options with pros, cons and confidence
Export a full product requirements document from the plan

entries.headline: A new advisor for what your agents waste
entries.summary: The Agents family gains an advisor that reads your local Claude Code history and tells you how much of your agent spend was avoidable, and why. Everything is priced at your own blended rate.

highlights.text: See how much of your agent spend was avoidable, and where it went
Spot repeated and stale file reads that quietly cost you money
Find volatile lines in your project instructions that break caching
Your transcripts stay on your machine; only totals are stored

entries.headline: Under-the-hood improvements
entries.summary: Nothing changes in how yeaboi works — this release is internal plumbing and fixes.

highlights.text: Internal release and verification improvements only

entries.headline: The agent digest says what it actually measured
entries.summary: When a digest runs somewhere it cannot see your local agent history, it now says so instead of reporting a zero total that read as free. Session highlights describe what an agent worked on.

highlights.text: A digest with nothing to measure says so, instead of showing zero spend
Run the digest away from your machine without it counting itself
Session highlights say what an agent did, not just what it cost

entries.headline: Notion pages are read all the way through
entries.summary: Long Notion pages were quietly cut off after the first hundred blocks. yeaboi now reads to the end, and marks anything it still could not finish.

highlights.text: Long Notion pages no longer get silently truncated
A partial read is flagged, so nothing goes quietly missing

entries.headline: Start a new project from your team's own work
entries.summary: For a greenfield project, Planning ranks your team's existing repositories and offers the relevant ones as prior art, with a plain pitch for each. Accepted ones feed the plan, the summary and exports.

highlights.text: See which of your team's repositories are worth reusing on a new project
Accepted prior art shapes the plan and shows up in the summary and exports
Turn one down once and yeaboi remembers your reason

entries.headline: Choose GitHub organisations, then exclude repos
entries.summary: Standup setup gives GitHub its own picker, plus a screen listing every repository in the organisations you chose. Everything is ticked by default, so new repositories get picked up on their own.

highlights.text: Pick GitHub organisations on their own screen, apart from Azure DevOps
Untick only the repositories you want left out; new ones are included
Setup and Settings now spell out the GitHub access your token needs

entries.headline: Share links close themselves after an hour
entries.summary: Every retro board, poker session and share stops being reachable 60 minutes after it opens, so nothing is left online by accident. You can change the limit in Settings, or turn expiry off.

highlights.text: Boards and shares stop being reachable an hour after you open them
Change the timeout in Settings, or switch expiry off entirely
An expired board offers a fresh link; an expired share simply closes

entries.headline: Pasting into the chat box behaves properly
entries.summary: Large pastes no longer spill into the terminal or lose line breaks and accented characters. The key hints now show the newline key that works everywhere, and clearing a line can be undone.

highlights.text: Paste long text without it leaking into the terminal as keystrokes
Line breaks and accented characters survive a paste from any platform
The hint row shows the newline key that works in every terminal
Undo a cleared draft instead of retyping it

entries.headline: Track a whole GitHub organisation in Standup
entries.summary: Pick GitHub organisations in Standup's code sources and every repository inside them is followed, the way Azure DevOps projects already worked. Repositories are rediscovered on each run.

highlights.text: Choose GitHub organisations instead of ticking repositories one by one
New repositories are picked up on the next run, with no reconfiguration
Each run looks at the most recently active repositories to stay quick

entries.headline: Live standups get the same editable share
entries.summary: A standup that is still running can now be shared for editing, not just a saved one. Sources that were skipped are named along with the reason, and one unreachable repository no longer stops the rest.

highlights.text: Share a live standup for editing, with the same history as a saved run
See which sources were skipped and why: not selected, no access, nothing found
Change your code sources from any standup page after setup
A GitHub error on one repository no longer blocks the others

entries.headline: Analysis scoring runs faster
entries.summary: Code health, coverage and practice scoring now run on a compiled background service with identical results. Nothing changes in how you use Analysis.

highlights.text: Code health and coverage scoring finish faster, with the same output
If the faster path is unavailable, Analysis carries on by itself

entries.headline: Agent scans and startup get much faster
entries.summary: The agent and Standup number-crunching now runs on a compiled background service: agent scans finish in about a second instead of half a minute, and the command line starts almost instantly.

highlights.text: Agent scans run in about a second instead of fifteen to thirty
The command line starts up in a fraction of the time
Nothing changes in how you use yeaboi; the speed-up is automatic

entries.headline: Documentation for the Agents family
entries.summary: Usage, Standup and Security for AI coding agents each have a documentation page explaining what they track and how to run them. The demo and the website now show the split between Humans and Agents.

highlights.text: Read what each agent mode tracks and how to run it
The demo tours both the Humans and the Agents menus

entries.headline: Standup reports say each thing once
entries.summary: Facts that used to repeat three or four times now appear once, quiet team members collapse into a single line, and vanity stats are gone. The tidier report goes to the browser, Slack and email alike.

highlights.text: Every fact appears once instead of being repeated across sections
People with no activity collapse into a single line
Merge and sync commits no longer pad out the evidence
A typical report comes out about a quarter shorter

entries.headline: Agent pages open instantly and show progress
entries.summary: Opening Usage, Standup or Security shows your last saved report straight away while a fresh one loads behind it. A checklist and a progress meter replace the scroll of per-file lines.

highlights.text: Your last report opens at once while a new one loads in the background
A phase checklist and percentage meter replace the scrolling file list
If a refresh fails, the previous report stays on screen

entries.headline: Standup groups each person's work under their story
entries.summary: Every teammate's card now leads with the story they are working on, with subtasks nested under it and a badge showing where it stands. Commits and docs file themselves under the story they mention.

highlights.text: Each person's card leads with their story, subtasks nested underneath
Badges show to do, in progress, done or blocked at a glance
Jira and Azure DevOps hierarchies are detected for you, with no extra setup
Commits and docs file under the story they reference, and orphans stay visible

entries.headline: yeaboi now watches AI agents, not just people
entries.summary: Pick Humans or Agents after the splash. The new Agents family prices your local Claude Code sessions, digests what your agents did and audits their setup, all computed on your own machine.

highlights.text: Choose Humans or Agents at the start, each with its own set of modes
See what your Claude Code sessions cost by model, project and day
Get a daily digest of agent sessions plus the commits and PRs they authored
Audit your agent setup for risky permissions and secrets left in transcripts

entries.headline: Turn off the background update check
entries.summary: You can now stop yeaboi from checking PyPI for a newer version in the background, which matters on air-gapped machines. The rest of this release is internal recording tooling.

highlights.text: Disable the background PyPI update check for air-gapped installs
Everything else here is internal tooling and changes nothing you see

entries.headline: yeaboi is now a standalone terminal agent
entries.summary: yeaboi no longer ships as a plugin for another agent tool, and the command that installed it there is gone. It stands on its own in the terminal, over the MCP server and as a Claude Code plugin.

highlights.text: The old third-party plugin integration and its install command are removed
yeaboi runs on its own across the terminal, the MCP server and the plugin

entries.headline: Install dictation without leaving yeaboi
entries.summary: Double-tap Space and yeaboi offers to set up voice input and download the Whisper model right there, with a real progress bar. Skip for now, or decline for good, and every screen agrees on what your machine can do.

highlights.text: Double-tap Space to install dictation and the Whisper model in place
Install now, skip this session, or never be asked again on this machine
A headless install command for containers and terminals without the full app
Voice readiness now reads the same in the input hint, tips and Settings

entries.headline: Upgrading restarts you onto the new version
entries.summary: After an in-app upgrade, yeaboi counts down and relaunches itself on the version you just installed, keeping the options you started with. Decline and you stay where you are.

highlights.text: yeaboi relaunches itself onto the new version seconds after upgrading
The options you launched with stay active through the restart
An updated marker appears next to the version once you are back
If the upgrade or the restart cannot happen, you are told plainly

entries.headline: Planning intake is faster to get through
entries.summary: Answer and submit with a single digit, see how many questions this run will really ask, and list the topics still coming. Long replies now arrive as cards instead of typing themselves out.

highlights.text: Press a digit to pick an answer and submit it in one keystroke
The progress line counts only the questions this run will actually ask
List the topics still to come, and pick your review verdict from a row
Long summaries land as cards, and small projects stay capped at two stories

entries.headline: Pick which microphone dictation uses
entries.summary: Voice input now records in whatever format your microphone actually supports, so USB and Bluetooth mics that used to fail just work. Choose and test a microphone in Settings, or switch mid-recording.

highlights.text: Choose and test your microphone from Settings
Switch microphones while recording, with a live input-level meter
USB and Bluetooth mics work: yeaboi records at the format they support
List your audio devices from the command line when a mic misbehaves

entries.headline: Standup no longer fails on a database error
entries.summary: Generating a standup could stop with a missing-column error. It now works, and every mode repairs its own storage when it opens, so this kind of failure heals itself.

highlights.text: Fixed Standup generation stopping with a missing-column database error
Modes now repair their own storage when they open

entries.headline: Planning stops asking your project size twice
entries.summary: The size you give at the greeting now carries into the chat, and later questions acknowledge it. Options that only apply to large projects are no longer offered on small ones.

highlights.text: Your project size is asked once and carried through the whole chat
Options that cannot apply to your project are no longer shown

entries.headline: The idle screensaver is now a yard of ducks
entries.summary: Leave yeaboi alone and a drift of ducks spins and bounces off each other and off one anchored duck in the middle. Small terminals keep the original single resting duck.

highlights.text: A yard of ducks drifts, spins and ricochets across the idle screensaver
Small terminals still show the original single resting duck

entries.headline: The duck follows you into every mode
entries.summary: He waddles in when you open a mode, bobs through long waits and quacks when the work lands. Long jobs no longer freeze the screen, and waiting screens show a live checklist with timings.

highlights.text: The duck shows up in every mode and reacts when a job finishes
Retro actions, performance reviews and publishing no longer freeze the screen
Waiting screens show a live checklist with per-stage timing
Mute the duck for one session or for good, and keep delete prompts visible

entries.headline: Share links stop serving Cloudflare errors
entries.summary: A board's share link is only handed to you once the tunnel is genuinely registered with Cloudflare, and a failed regional lookup retries on its own. Cancelling a board no longer leaves a tunnel running.

highlights.text: Share links appear only once they actually work
A failed regional lookup retries instead of erroring forever
Cancelling a board session cleans up its tunnel

entries.headline: Planning is now a live chat, not a form
entries.summary: Describe your project in your own words and watch epics, stories, tasks and sprints appear as cards while the agent drafts them. You can still drop back to the classic form at any point.

highlights.text: Plan by chatting, with the agent streaming its thinking as it gathers details
Watch epics, stories, tasks and sprints render as cards as they are drafted
Skip a question, finish fast, or switch back to the classic form mid-intake
Pick Small or Large up front, or let yeaboi size the project for you

entries.headline: Analysis can now read your GitHub repositories
entries.summary: GitHub is offered in the Analysis setup alongside Azure DevOps, with your owners, organizations and repositories discovered from the token you already gave. What you pick is saved for next time.

highlights.text: Choose GitHub as a code source when setting up Analysis
Owners, organizations and repositories are discovered for you
The GitHub owners you pick are remembered for future runs
Fine-grained GitHub tokens work, even when they cannot list organizations

entries.headline: Standup flags habits that cost the team later
entries.summary: It spots work landing with no ticket, boards left stale after a merge, too much open at once and changes too big to review, naming the exact commits every time. Thumb a wrong call down and it stays hidden.

highlights.text: See untracked work, stale boards and oversized changes, per person
Every signal names the exact changes it saw, with no guesswork involved
Thumb a wrong signal down to hide it, or up to confirm it is right
Vote from the terminal or from the shared page, and the verdict sticks

entries.headline: Standup asks you for the meeting transcript
entries.summary: Paste it, pipe it, drag the file in, or point Standup at the folder your recordings land in. Standups that never got checked against a meeting are surfaced quietly, then offered off.

highlights.text: Paste, pipe or drag in a standup transcript, with no folder hunt first
Your Zoom, Google Meet and Downloads folders are found and offered by name
Standups never checked against their meeting are surfaced, not silently lost
An optional reminder after standup, silent when nothing is unchecked

entries.headline: Teammates can fix a shared standup themselves
